pins.description: What else belongs in a wildlife record? Note the weather as well as visitors and clues, then compare what you notice over five days. The free Nature Tracker gives your family a place to record those observations. Get it with an adult email.

pins.title: Shorebird watching for kids: notice behaviour before learning names
pins.description: Do we need to know a bird’s name to watch it? No. Keep your distance and spend five minutes tallying what one shorebird does, such as pecking, running or resting. Supervise children and avoid nesting birds. Try the free Shorebird Behaviour Watch.
